Facilitator's Guide: Saving Intake Packet and Extracted Intake Documents to SA

Tabs to check, update and actions to be done by the trainee on SA.

A. Verify the Correct Client Case / Matter in SA

Before doing any work in SmartAdvocate, always ensure that you are on the correct client project or matter.

a. Confirm the client’s full name and case number. b. Verify that you are inside the correct case/matter of the client in SmartAdvocate. c. If the client has multiple matters, verify the DO to ensure you are working on the correct project. d. For training/demo purposes, trainees should narrate that they are verifying the correct matter, assuming the verification step even if using a training account or dummy matter.

B. Check the Assigned Task in the TASK MENU

a. Check the assigned task in the TASK MENU. b. Tasks may also be communicated by the Case Manager or Attorney via email or chat for urgent matters. c. Double-click the assigned task row to open the task details. d. Review the DESCRIPTION BOX carefully for all instructions and case-specific details. e. Copy and paste the important task details into Notepad for quick reference while working, to avoid repeatedly reopening the task.

C. Review the Intake Packet and Identify Available Documents

a. Open the assigned intake packet “received from the client.” b. Review the packet and determine which intake documents are included. c. Extract the available intake documents one by one from the packet, as applicable. d. Not all intake packets are complete, some documents may be missing. If so:

•extract, rename, and save only the documents that are available;

•follow firm SOP regarding missing documents; and

•notify the Case Manager or Attorney if needed, especially if the VA is not authorized to contact the client directly.

Common Intake Documents That May Be Included in the Packet

(Trainee may mention that an intake packet can contain multiple document types, but not all will always be present.)

Examples include:

•Signed Contingency Fee Agreement

•Client Communication Disclosure

•PD Claim

•HITECH

•Internet and Surveillance Acknowledgment

•Consent for Disclosure of Information

•General Release

•Limited Power of Attorney

•HIPAA Authorization

•Signed Medicare Form / Not a Medicare Recipient Form

•ISO Claim Search

•Conflict of Interest Waiver/ Notice and Waiver of Potential Conflict of Interest

•Attorney’s Lien

•Client Information Sheet

•MVA Questionnaire

•1P Driver’s License

•3P Driver’s License

•1P ID

•NPIM Referral Form

•Certificates of Signature

•Insurance vs. Lien Disclaimer

•Affidavit of Communication

D. Prepare the Original Intake Packet and Extracted Intake Documents for Upload

a. Ensure the original intake packet is properly named according to the firm’s naming convention. b. Ensure each extracted intake document is also properly renamed using the correct naming convention. c. Confirm that all files are complete, readable, and ready for upload. d. Double-check that there are no duplicate or incorrect files before uploading.

Important Reminder:Uploading the wrong file or creating duplicate uploads is a NO-NO because VAs do not have permission to delete documents in SA. Always verify the file before uploading.

E. Upload the Original Intake Packet in the DOCUMENTS TAB

a. Go to the DOCUMENTS TAB of the client project in SmartAdvocate. b. Upload the original or renamed intake packet. c. Upload ONE FILE AT A TIME since SA can’t accommodate multiple uploads simultaneously.

d. After uploading the file, set the following properties:

•Direction: Incoming

•Search for Sub-category: Intake, Intake

•Category/Sub-category: These will auto-populate based on the selected search value

•Folder: Intake \ Intake Documents

•FROM: Type the client’s matter/project name (example: DUMMY ACCOUNT, DOCGEN I., DC)

•TO: Check the box OUR FIRM

•DESCRIPTION: Paste the complete filename including the file extension, exactly as reflected in the saved file

e. Click SAVE once all properties are completed.

Important: Do not leave the Description field blank. This becomes the searchable file name/description in the Documents Tab and Tasks Tab. If left empty, the file will be difficult to locate later.

F. Verify That the Original Intake Packet Was Uploaded Successfully

a. Use the Description Filter Box in the Documents Tab. b. Enter the full filename of the uploaded intake packet. c. Verify that the file has been successfully uploaded and the properties have been set correctly.

G. Copy the Internal Link of the Original Intake Packet

a. Hover over Email/Share Link of the uploaded original intake packet. b. Click COPY INTERNAL LINK. c. Paste the internal link into your Notepad. d. This internal link will be used later when reporting the task in the Notes Tab.

Reminder: The internal link should be copied from the original intake packet, since this is the main file that will be referenced in the Notes and Task reporting.

H. Repeat the Same Upload Process for All Extracted Intake Documents

a. Upload each extracted intake document in the DOCUMENTS TAB, ONE FILE AT A TIME. b. For each extracted document, set the same standard document properties:

•Direction: Incoming

•Search for Sub-category: Intake, Intake

•Folder: Intake \ Intake Documents

•FROM: Client’s matter/project name

•TO: OUR FIRM

•DESCRIPTION: Complete filename including file extension

c. Click SAVE after each upload. d. Verify each file after upload by:

•filtering using the filename, and/or

•opening the file to confirm it is the correct document.

Reminder for Trainees:The same process should be repeated for all extracted intake documents until all available files are uploaded and verified.

I. Report the Completed Upload in the NOTES TAB

a. After uploading the original intake packet and all extracted intake documents, go to the NOTES TAB. b. You may access the Notes page through:

•the Quick Add Toolbar, or

•the Left Navigation Pane.

c. Click ADD NEW NOTE. d. Select the correct required fields from the drop-down menus (all fields marked with an asterisk). e. Use the correct note type (Task) and report template required by the firm.

Template Body for Notes Tab:

Received [the entire naming convention of the original file EXCLUDING your name]. Saved in Docs Tab. Thank you. (VA’s Name)

Example:

Received Intake Packet – Ricardo Zazueta – 03.11.2026. Saved in Docs Tab. Thank you. (Michelle)

f. Highlight the naming convention of the original file in the note. g. Click the globe with chain icon (hyperlink tool). h. Paste the internal link you copied earlier. i. Click SAVE to finalize the note.

J. Add a Note / Update in the TASKS TAB

a. Return to the TASKS TAB through the Left Navigation Panel. b. Locate the assigned task related to Intake Packet and Intake Documents Saving. c. Double-click the task to open it. d. Scroll to the end of the Description Box. e. Leave one space after the “Thank you!”, then add your report using the proper task note format. If there are already reports from the other trainees, enter your report directly below the most recent one.

Template Body for Tasks Tab:

mm/dd/yyyy – Received completed Intake Packet from [Client’s Name]. Saved in Docs Tab. Thank you. (VA’s Name)

Example:

03/11/2026 – Received completed Intake Packet from Ricardo Zazueta. Saved in Docs Tab. Thank you. (Michelle)

K. Attach a Copy of the Original Intake Packet to the Tasks Tab

a. While still inside the task panel, click SELECT to attach a related document. b. Search for the uploaded original intake packet. c. Tick the checkbox beside the correct file. d. Click SELECT. e. Confirm that the file now appears under Related Documents in the task panel.

L. Verify the Task Update

a. Click SAVE in the task panel after adding the task note and attaching the related document. b. Confirm that the update was saved successfully by checking:

•the Tasks Tab, or

•the Summary Tab.

c. If corrections are needed:

•reopen the task by double-clicking it,

•make the necessary changes, and

•click SAVE again.

Facilitator’s Notes: Trainer Facilitated Demo, Saving the Intake Packet and Extracted Intake Documents to SA

  • The demo runs at the same time as the shadowing when a shadow buddy confirms a session: pull the trainees from it one by one for their individual demonstration. Without live shadowing, provide a recorded shadowing session.
  • Provide the SA credentials, the 2nd one listed. Change it back to the 1st one at the end of each shift, and to the 2nd again whenever trainees need the CMS: this keeps the active cases in the CMS safe from unsupervised exploring, and follows the firm’s policy, as directed by the Operations Manager, that VAs are not permitted to alter it.
  • There are 2 training accounts in SA (Jane Doe & John Doe / DOCGEN Dummy Account): post the tasks in the SA Tasks tab for BOTH accounts.

Sample task in the DESCRIPTION box:

***** Intake Packet and Intake Documents Saving Tasks: Batch B022026 ***
03/06/2025 Please save the client’s Intake Packet and extract intake documents in the client’s project.
Documents to save:
1. INTAKE PACKET - 1 (Martin)
2. INTAKE PACKET - 2 (Michelle)
3. INTAKE PACKET - 3 (Mikee)
Thank you!

  • Check before the demo that every intake document has been extracted from the assigned Intake Packet, and that every file, the Intake Packet included, is renamed under the firm’s naming convention: these are the exact files uploaded and reported on SA.
  • Give each trainee 10–15 minutes to explore SA first: it doesn’t allow more than one user at the same time.
